audit_criteria.content: Mailbox Audit Criteria (sheet SHEET-AUD-2026Q2). C1 SLA: first response within 24h of open. C2 Assignment: every Open/Pending conversation must have an assigned agent. C3 Tagging: every conversation must carry at least one category tag. C4 Aging: no Open conversation older than 3 business days without a status note. C5 Sensitive data: no full payment-card or password values in thread bodies. Severity scale: High (C1/C2 breach), Medium (C3/C4 breach), Low (advisory).
